notes.content:
[h1] Itch.io users[/h1]
If you have purchased the game in itch.io a key for the Steam version will be sent to you, so wait for it in your inbox!

notes.title: Itch.io users
notes.content:
[h1] Itch.io users[/h1]
If you have purchased the game in itch.io you can ask for a Steam key sending an email to steamkey@pikewin.com with the subject "Nekomew's Potty Trouble Steam Key"!
